caseNameFull: Indianapolis Glove Co. v. Bowles, Price Administrator
attorneys: Messrs. William H. Thompson, Perry E. O’Neal and Patrick J. Smith for petitioner., Solicitor General McGrath and Mr. David London for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Rutledge took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
